plain: A fixed sum of money paid out every year

webster.text: A sum of money, payable yearly, to continue for a given number of years, for life or for ever; an annual income, charged on the person of the grantor; or an annual allowance.

example.quote: Annuity of ten pounds each for life for all poor persons, decayed tradesmen, and others (supposed seventy thousand) of the age of sixty years.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
